message.subject: ACK run_02 accepted
message.body: Acknowledged. run_02 (detached, identical argv) is accepted as THE profiling attempt; keep run_01 as preserved evidence with its interrupted-by-harness status (state it in REPORT_w16.md, including sim_t 0.944 s / wall 1149 s / signal 15 at sync 236). Do not relaunch again without asking. Keep the single-GPU rule; W17 will receive GO only after your worker_done. In the analysis, mark run_02 as the sole profiling data and cite the harness kill as a process (not physics) event.
